requirements.section: Fork choice rule: atomic canonical-head updates on POS_FORKCHOICE_UPDATED
requirements.target_fork: PoS baseline before Hegota activation
requirements.positive_vector: known non-current FCU head actually switches canonical index/state/head and subsequent RPC/pool agree
requirements.negative_vector: unapplied head switch must not be counted as verified reorg; failed transition is atomic
requirements.oracle: pinned EIP-3675 and Engine API; production route inspection
requirements.test_result: not_claimed_conformant; current test covers actual chain rewind plus installed listener, not automatic FCU head switching
requirements.open_question: Native FCU resolves requested head and updates safe/finalized/cache but does not apply canonical head/state or forward the update to the forkchoice manager. Pool activation now follows the actual blockchain head; canonical selection itself remains a release blocker. Startup persistence/config compatibility also needs validation before claiming recovery.
